fields.review_resolved: the independent review of 935cfdd8 (PASS, F1 to F3 low) is resolved by Decision 0132: F1 (the CLI's pack reader applies the knowledge component's text rule before any host is launched, and a wire test shows the largest chunk of documentation text fits one frame), F2 (an import is refused unless deletion records and kept versions together stay within the store's deletion bound, so retention, deletion and reads keep working when the history is full), F3 (tests for a refused begin discarding a staged import, the host's own chunk bound and a version obtained after the last change); N3 corrects the store module's wording and N6 adds a head dated backwards alone

components.scope: component, store, host-unit, wire, CLI and actual-process row: operational store migration 24 and the kernel owner state store (first revision one, each later state one higher, no deletion, digests checked at every open, load and export); the knowledge memory catalog state encoded in the plaintext of its portable form; the catalog host's memory owner over IPC wire 13; the CLI's --memory-* operations and the harness memory subcommand; the actual CLI and catalog host remembered, listed, revoked by item and by source within one workspace, and deleted memory items in this sandbox

component, host-unit, wire, CLI and actual-process row: the catalog host's extension catalog as one owner state, per workspace scope, with trusted package signer and revocation issuer keys, installed extensions verified through the capability package component and the accepted signed revocation list; every operation re-verifies the exact stored encoding; IPC wire 14, the CLI's --extension-* operations, the harness extension and extension-sample subcommands; the actual CLI and catalog host trusted keys, installed signed packages, applied, refused and kept apart signed lists in two scopes in this sandbox; no coding run reads the extension catalog and nothing an extension declares is granted or run

fields.mutation_checks: run before each source commit with private tooling, each applying one exact replacement and running the package filter: for 025e3fd5, 17 single mutations over the owner state store, the memory owner, the CLI and the client, all caught; for 709f8d7a, 41 single mutations over the extension owner's decoding, verification, trust, installation, revocation, acknowledgment and file-reading rules, the review fixes (the pack reader's text rule, the history bound and its default, the begin discard, the chunk bound and its frame, the restore rule, the kept version count, the store's day rule) and the owner list; 40 made their expected test fail at once, and the survivor (scope order checked with a strict comparison, which only a duplicated scope distinguishes) exposed a missing test, which was added; the rerun caught it. These runs are not retained logs
